name: mstack-anonymize
description: Replaces identifying values in a file or a text before it goes to an AI model or to other people. A script in the skill folder does the work on your machine: the agent never opens the raw file, your terms file or a result written to disk, and reports only a count per kind. It finds values by their form (e-mail addresses, phone numbers, cards, IBANs, IP addresses, hosts, credentials, amounts, identifiers), by the name of a column or a JSON key in English, German and Spanish, and by a list of names you keep. The same value gets the same placeholder, so the data stays usable, and no file links a placeholder to its original. Text, Markdown, logs, CSV, TSV and JSON in, Markdown out, as a file or in the chat. Every result says that it may still be personal data: this is pseudonymisation, not legal anonymization. Node.js 18 or later, nothing to install. One skill for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Identifying values replaced by a local script before data goes to a model.
interface.longDescription: Replaces personal, customer and company identifiers in a text, a log, a table or JSON with placeholders, through a script that runs on your machine. The agent never opens the raw file or your list of names, and reports a count per kind. Values are found by their form, by column and key names in English, German and Spanish, and by a terms file you keep. The result is Markdown, as a file or in the chat, and always says that it may still be personal data.
